content.title: Micro-Carrier FPV Loop | Obstacle Chapters Return to the Product
content.summary: Establish a miniature flying carrier beside product packaging and human-scale references. Keep a low forward FPV route through obstacles with distinct navigation rules, repeat one shape or color to guide the return, then decelerate into a stable product reunion and one restrained identity effect.

quick_start.input_format: micro flying carrier, product anchor, and human-scale object established together + continuous forward FPV through at least three obstacle chapters with distinct navigation rules and visible exits + carrier identity, direction, and near-miss physics stay continuous + repeated shape, color, or opening guides the route back to the product geography + clear deceleration and stable reunion precede one restrained product effect and short name
quick_start.recommended_input: A graphite tool battery, cobalt micro-drone, adult work glove, and oversized screws share the opening. The drone follows amber hexagonal vents through fin, cable, and casing chapters, then slows and docks over the original vent as one circular charge light reveals VOLT NEST.
required_anchors: Show one micro carrier, one product and human-scale objects together before flight.
Use at least three forward obstacle chapters with different navigation rules and visible exits.
Repeat one shape, color or opening to redirect the route toward original product geography.
Decelerate, reunite carrier and product, then use one restrained effect and concise name.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish a miniature flying carrier beside product packaging and human-scale references. Keep a low forward FPV route through obstacles with distinct navigation rules, repeat one shape or color to guide the return, then decelerate into a stable product reunion and one restrained identity effect.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original micro-scale flying carrier, one product anchor and a human-scale environment in the same frame so relative size is immediate. Maintain a continuous forward FPV route through at least three obstacle chapters that change navigation rule—such as low tabletop weave, soft environmental corridor and enclosed organic tunnel—while every chapter retains a visible exit gap. Use one repeated shape, color or opening to redirect the carrier back toward the original product geography. Decelerate before the product return, then let the carrier land or hover in a stable relation to the package before one restrained product-state effect and concise name lockup. The reusable mechanism is micro scale, continuous FPV, changing obstacle grammar, visible exits, motif-guided return, deceleration and product reunion—not the source bee, picnic, people, child, dog, foods, flowers, fruit, cans, branding, exact route, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Show one micro carrier, one product and human-scale objects together before flight.
invariants.purpose: Makes scale and terminal objective measurable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting in abstract flight loses product context.

invariants.rule: Use at least three forward obstacle chapters with different navigation rules and visible exits.
invariants.purpose: Creates progression without disorienting the route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Identical weaving becomes repetitive; hidden exits feel random.

invariants.rule: Keep carrier identity, heading logic and near-miss clearance physically continuous.
invariants.ablation_failure: Teleporting or intersecting objects breaks FPV credibility.

invariants.rule: Repeat one shape, color or opening to redirect the route toward original product geography.
invariants.purpose: Turns the return into designed recall rather than coincidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated cut back to the package breaks the journey.

invariants.rule: Decelerate, reunite carrier and product, then use one restrained effect and concise name.
invariants.purpose: Lets motion resolve into a legible commercial payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: A high-speed logo collision makes the product unreadable.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source bee, body, stripes, wings, scale and exact flight behavior
the source adults, child, dog, faces, hands and picnic participants
the source picnic cloth, AKOOL cans, berries, bread, honey, flowers, petals and fruit interiors
the source brand name, logo, slogan, energy plume, package design and all typography
the source FPV route, transitions, creator identity, Seedance 2.5 wording and 30-second timing
